instruction: Create a single-page SVG botanical study of a green clover. Make one detailed three-leaf clover the dominant specimen, with three heart-shaped leaflets, a curved stem, visible veins, subtle serration and natural color variation. Add a few restrained scientific or field-note accents without competing with the plant. Put strong emphasis on organic silhouette, believable botanical detail, layered green tones, generous negative space, and refined vector finish.
